body.name: Selected-trust separation and gain witnesses
body.construction: Specialize to \(\mathcal E=\{a,b,c_\star\}\), \(T_0=\{a,b\}\), and \(\rho=1/2\). Choose \(r_0,r_1\in(31/50,17/25)\), \(s_0,s_1,\tau_a,\tau_b\in(2/5,3/5)\), \(\lambda_0\in(3/100,7/100)\), and \(\lambda_1\in(93/100,97/100)\), and put \(A_z=(1-r_z)s_z\) and \(B_z=(1-r_z)(1-s_z)\). Under \(q^{\rm sep}_{r,s,\tau,\lambda}\), let \(X_0\) and \(X_1\) be independent categorical variables with \(\Pr(X_z=a)=A_z\), \(\Pr(X_z=b)=B_z\), and \(\Pr(X_z=c_\star)=r_z\); independently draw \(V_a\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(\tau_a)\), \(V_b\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(\tau_b)\), \(W_{c_\star0}\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(\lambda_0)\), and \(W_{c_\star1}\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(\lambda_1)\). Its observed table is \(p^{{\rm sep},z}_{a0}=A_z(1-\tau_a)\), \(p^{{\rm sep},z}_{a1}=A_z\tau_a\), \(p^{{\rm sep},z}_{b0}=B_z(1-\tau_b)\), \(p^{{\rm sep},z}_{b1}=B_z\tau_b\), \((p^{{\rm sep},0}_{c_\star0},p^{{\rm sep},0}_{c_\star1})=(r_0(1-\lambda_0),r_0\lambda_0)\), and \((p^{{\rm sep},1}_{c_\star0},p^{{\rm sep},1}_{c_\star1})=(r_1(1-\lambda_1),r_1\lambda_1)\). Define \(p^{\rm gain}\), in cell order \((a,0),(a,1),(b,0),(b,1),(c_\star,0),(c_\star,1)\), by \[p^{{\rm gain},0}=\tfrac1{10}(1,1,1,1,5,1),\qquad p^{{\rm gain},1}=\tfrac1{10}(1,1,1,1,2,4).\]
